hero.title: AI-Native
hero.subtitle: A coordinated system of specialized agents that research, evaluate, and execute systematic strategies — every decision passing through deterministic validation and disciplined risk controls.

intelligence.technicalDescription: Analyzes trend, momentum, volatility, price structure, and technical indicators across multiple timeframes.
intelligence.macroDescription: Evaluates interest rates, inflation, monetary policy, and macroeconomic conditions that drive market regimes.
intelligence.newsDescription: Processes market-moving events, sentiment shifts, scheduled economic releases, and geopolitical risk.
intelligence.structureDescription: Analyzes liquidity zones, market structure, institutional levels, order flow concepts, and structural breaks.

decision.description: Three simple steps: four analysts send signals, the master forms a single thesis, then the thesis passes through risk gates before execution.

breakeven.description: Drag the slider to see how Lumine adapts its stop-loss based on market structure.
breakeven.disclaimer: Conceptual feature. Not a guarantee of better returns. This demonstrates Lumine's structure-aware trade management philosophy.

research.description: Continuous discovery and validation of systematic strategies.
research.lifecycleDescription: Every strategy must survive this lifecycle before real capital is deployed.
research.stage01Description: Continuous data ingestion and regime detection.
research.stage02Description: Strategy hypotheses from observed market patterns.
research.stage05Description: Live paper trading with zero capital risk.
research.stage06Description: Controlled capital with strict risk limits.

performance.description: Live metrics across all strategies and agents.

philosophy.manifestoDescription: Lumine is built on the assumption that markets will surprise us. Our intelligence layer proposes. Our risk engine decides. Our validation framework ensures we only deploy what we understand.
